_published_faq.name: How do I add Simply.com public to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Simply.com public to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.simply.com/public.

_published_faq.name: Is Simply.com public MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Simply.com public scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Simply.com public MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply.com public provides these MCP tools: check-domain-availability, list-supported-tlds, create-order-link, and list-products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Simply.com public?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Simply.com public in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Simply.com public MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply.com public does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Simply.com public is developed by Simply.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
